overall_summary: Bitcoin is positioned for further upside after ETF inflows resumed and the price reclaimed sixty-two K on softer jobs data. Easing rate-hike odds provide a supportive macro backdrop that outweighs lingering geopolitical noise.
key_points: Bitcoin ETFs post two-hundred twenty-one M inflows, breaking outflow streak
Price rebounds above sixty-two K on weak June jobs report
Fed hike bets ease, supporting risk assets
More Bitcoin held at loss than profit, neutral signal
Geopolitical tensions remain but lack immediate market impact

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap 10-Day Outflow Streak With $221M Inflows
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in a net $221 million on July 3, the largest single-day inflow in about two months and the first above $200 million since early May. This ended a 10-day outflow run that drained more than $2.7 billion from the products, with Fidelity leading the way at roughly $166 million. Traders should care because sustained ETF inflows are a key institutional demand signal that often supports higher prices and reduces selling pressure.
items.impact: Supports higher Bitcoin prices and improves sentiment.

items.title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $62K on Weak Jobs Data
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $62,000 on July 3 after soft US jobs numbers raised odds of Fed rate cuts and triggered around $450 million in short liquidations. The move came despite ongoing ETF outflows earlier in the streak and follows a test of the $60,000 area. Traders should care because macro relief and forced buying can fuel short-term momentum even when fundamentals are mixed.
items.impact: Adds near-term upward pressure on price.

items.title: More Bitcoin Now Held at a Loss Than at a Profit
items.summary: On-chain data shows more Bitcoin is currently underwater than in profit for the first time in a while, a classic capitulation metric. Bitcoin held above $62,000 with modest daily gains while the broader market advanced. Traders should care because these washed-out conditions have historically marked local bottoms and can precede sharp rebounds when buying returns.
items.impact: Suggests potential for a relief rally if support holds.

items.title: Weak June Jobs Report Eases Fed Hike Bets
items.summary: The June employment report showed only 57,000 new jobs added, well below expectations, with prior months revised lower. This data, released just before the holiday, has lowered the odds of a September Fed rate hike and provided some relief to risk assets including crypto and gold. Traders should watch how this soft labor print influences rate expectations and dollar strength when markets reopen.
items.impact: Supports risk assets by reducing near-term tightening odds.

items.title: US Markets Closed for July 4 Holiday
items.summary: No major US economic data or Fed events are scheduled today as markets observe Independence Day. Trading in futures and crypto remains light with limited catalysts until next week. Traders can use the quiet period to assess the jobs data fallout without fresh headlines driving volatility.
items.impact: Low volume, range-bound price action likely.

items.title: Iran Begins Massive Funeral for Slain Leader Khamenei
items.summary: Millions are expected in Tehran for days of mourning after the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. US-Iran indirect peace talks in Doha have been paused for at least a week to allow the ceremonies. The pause leaves uncertainty over any deal on the Strait of Hormuz and broader regional de-escalation.
items.impact: Keeps oil and risk assets volatile amid unresolved Middle East tensions.

items.title: Russia Launches Deadliest Strike on Kyiv This Year
items.summary: Hundreds of Russian drones and dozens of missiles hit Ukraine's capital overnight, killing at least 30 people and injuring scores more. The attack damaged over 130 buildings, mostly residential, in what Kyiv officials called the deadliest assault on the city this year.
items.impact: Escalates Ukraine conflict, likely increasing pressure for more Western aid and sustaining European energy and defense market uncertainty.

items.title: US Marks 250th Anniversary Amid Global Geopolitical Strains
items.summary: America celebrates its 250th Independence Day with major events including a Trump address at Mount Rushmore. While largely domestic, ongoing talks with Iran and the Ukraine war remain in focus for US policy.
items.impact: Limited direct market move but underscores US focus on domestic stability over new foreign entanglements.
